Counsel for Petitioner :- Sanjay Kr. Srivastava,Vivek Kumar Singh Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.

1. Heard Sri Sanjay Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Sri Vibhav Ojha,
learned AGA appearing for the State respondents.

2. This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 24.8.2023, in Case Crime No. 134 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.
Act, Police Station Vindhyachal, District Mirzapur.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents submitted that the charge-sheet no. 169 of 2023 has been forwarded on 6.11.2023 in the present case and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
4. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous.
